item.title: Are you sure that Kimmel clip was real? Late-night AI deepfakes are spreading online
item.description: While social media is rife with AI celebrity deepfakes, videos featuring late night TV hosts like Jimmy Kimmel and Jon Stewart are are easier to create than other kinds of deepfakes and potentially more disruptive.

item.title: Week in Politics: Trump renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America'; Fed chair signals hikes
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order to change the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America to provoke Canadian leaders. Meanwhile, the new Fed chair says inflation continues to be a problem.

item.title: Why is one WNBA team calling in national security experts?
item.description: The WNBA's popularity has risen in recent years, but so have threats and abuse directed at its players. One team is taking a novel approach to this, by partnering with national security specialists.

item.title: The Social Security trust fund is running out, and yet it's not a top campaign issue

item.title: How Democrats in Congress are preparing for Trump midterm election interference
